# API specifications

| Version | Description                                                                                                       | Redoc            | OpenAPI                        |
|---------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------|--------------------------------|
| 1.0.0   | Generate stylized QR codes (classic, rounded, gradient, embedded) with supported output PNG, JPEG, WebP, and SVG. | [/redoc](/redoc) | [/openapi.json](/openapi.json) |

## Overview

The QR Code API allows developers to generate highly customizable QR codes. You can embed logos, apply color masks, select output formats, and control QR code versions and error correction levels. This API is ideal for web applications, marketing campaigns, and analytics solutions that require QR code generation on the fly.

## 📚 Documentation

Endpoints are prefixed with the API version, e.g. for version 1:

```shell
/v1/qr
```

---

## 🚀 Endpoints

### `POST /v1/qr`

#### Request Body

| Field            | Type         | Description                                                                                                                                | Default                               | Allowed Values                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
|------------------|--------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| data*            | string       | The content to encode in the QR code.                                                                                                      | -                                     | a string value (e.g. URL).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| version          | integer/null | QR code version (1–40). <br/><br/>Not set or `null` for auto-fit.                                                                          | -                                     | `1` to `40`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| fit              | boolean/null | Automatically fit QR code and/or if the version is not set. <br/><br/>Disable to force creating QR with specified `version`.               | `true`                                | `true`, `false`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| mask_pattern     | integer/null | Changes which modules are dark and which are light according to a [particular rule](https://www.thonky.com/qr-code-tutorial/data-masking). | - (automatic best mask pattern)       | `0` to `7`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| error_correction | string       | Error correction level. <br/><br/>- L (~7%)<br/>- M (~15%)<br/>- Q (~25%)<br/>- H (~30%). <br/><br/>(Must be 'H' if a logo is provided)    | `M`                                   | `L`, `M`, `Q`, `H`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| output           | object       | Output format and options<br/> `as_json` denotes to output result as JSON with `data_uri` key.                                             | `{"format": "png", "as_json": false}` | - `format`: `png`, `jpeg`, `webp`, `svg` <br/>- `as_json`: `true`, `false`                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| box_size         | integer/null | Size of each QR code box in pixels.                                                                                                        | `10`                                  | an integer value.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| border           | integer/null | Width of the border around the QR code.                                                                                                    | `4`                                   | an integer value                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| module_drawer    | string/null  | Module drawer style (affects QR code shape).                                                                                               | `square_module`                       | one of `svg_square`, `svg_circle`, `svg_path_square`, `svg_path_circle`, `square_module`, `gapped_square_module`, `circle_module`, `rounded_module`, `vertical_bars`, `horizontal_bars`.                                                                           |
| logo             | object/null  | Optional logo configuration to embed image in the center. When provided, error correction must be `H`.                                     | -                                     | object with fields:<br/>- `image`: base64-encoded logo<br/>- `ratio`: Controls logo size (0.0–1.0; default `0.25`).<br/>- `filter`: Resampling filter used for resizing (one of `nearest`, `box`, `bilinear`, `hamming`, `bicubic`, `lanczos`; default `lanczos`). |
| color_mask       | object/null  | Optional color mask to style the QR code.                                                                                                  | -                                     | one of `solid`, `radial`, `square`, `horizontal`, `vertical`, `image`                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| fill_color       | object       | Foreground color of the QR code.                                                                                                           | `{"r":0,"g":0,"b":0}`                 | RGB object (0–255 each)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| back_color       | object       | Background color of the QR code.                                                                                                           | `{"r":255,"g":255,"b":255}`           | RGB object (0–255 each)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| eye_drawer       | object/null  | Optional configuration to customize the appearance of the three finder patterns (eyes).                                                    | -                                     | See [ configuration details](#eye-drawer-configuration).                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
* Required field

#### Eye Drawer Configuration

The `eye_drawer` object customizes the three main finder patterns (eyes) located at `top_left`, `top_right`, and `bottom_left`. Each eye consists of an `outer` frame (7x7 modules) and an `inner` eyeball (3x3 modules).

_Structure_

```json
{
  "eye_drawer": {
    "top_left": {
      "inner": {
        "radius": 0,
        "outline": {"r": 0, "g": 0, "b": 0},
        "corners": [true, true, true, true]
      },
      "outer": { /* ... */ }
    },
    "top_right": { /* ... */ },
    "bottom_left": { /* ... */ }
  }
}
```

#### Eye Component Style Object (`inner` or `outer`)

| Field     | Type              | Description                                                                                                                         | Default                    | Allowed Values                                                                                                                        |
 |-----------|-------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `radius`  | float             | Sets the rounding of the corners. A value of `0.0` is a square; `1.0` is a circle. Everything in between makes it a rounded square. | `0.0`                      | `0.0` to `1.0`                                                                                                                        |
| `outline` | object            | The color of the eye component. This color is also used as the fill color for the `inner` eyeball.                                  | `{"r":0,"g":0,"b":0}`      | RGB object (0–255 each)                                                                                                               |
| `corners` | array of booleans | Specifies which of the four corners should be rounded, starting from the top-left and going clockwise.                              | `[true, true, true, true]` | An array of 4 booleans, e.g., `[true, true, true, false]` denoting the corners `top-left`, `top-right`, `bottom-right`, `bottom-left` |

!!! tip

    For more details, please check the generated [Redoc](/redoc) documentation.

## ✍️ Examples

### ⬛ Standard

**Request**

```json
{
  "data": "https://example.com"
}
```

**Response**

<img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Basic QR Example" width="300" />

### 🟨 Custom Background & Foreground Colors

**Request**

```json
{
  "data": "https://example.com",
  "fill_color": { "r": 0, "g": 47, "b": 167 },
  "back_color": { "r": 167, "g": 120, "b": 0 },
  "module_drawer": "square_module"
}
```


!!! warning

    If both `color_mask` and `fill_color`/`back_color` are used, then `color_mask` takes precedence.

!!! danger

    The following properties are not supported when using `fill_color`/`back_color`.

    - `logo`
    - `eye_drawer` 2

!!! tip

    You can use `color_mask` to achieve the same result as using `fill_color`/`back_color`, however `color_mask` _does_ support using `logo` or `eye_drawer` properties.

**Response**

<img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Custom Color Example" width="300" />

### 🟦 Solid Background & Foreground Color Mask

**Request**

```json
{
  "data": "https://example.com",
  "color_mask": {
    "type": "solid",
    "options": {
      "back_color": { "r": 0, "g": 128, "b": 255},
      "front_color": { "r": 255, "g": 0, "b": 128 }
    }
  },
  "module_drawer": {
    "type": "rounded_module"
  }
}
```

**Response**

<img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Gradient QR Example" width="300" />

### ⏸️ Vertical Bars Small (using `shrink`)

**Request**

```json
{
  "data": "https://example.com",
  "color_mask": {
    "type": "solid",
    "options": {
      "back_color": { "r": 250, "g": 150, "b": 0},
      "front_color": { "r": 0, "g": 0, "b": 180 }
    }
  },
  "module_drawer": {
    "type": "vertical_bars",
    "shrink": 0.3
  }
}
```

!!! warning

    If the `shrink` value approaches `0`, the module size (bars) becomes to small for a scanner to read the QR code.

### 💾 JSON Data URI Output

**Request**

```json
{
  "data": "https://example.com",
  "output": {
    "format": "png",
    "as_json": true
  }
}
```

**Response**

```json
{
  "data_uri": "data:image/png;base64,"
}
```

## 🔶 SVG specific

This section shows SVG specific options and examples that can be used to create QR codes in SVG format.

When choosing a `svg_` module drawer, the additional options `ratio` and `style` can be used:

```json
{
    "module_drawer": {
        "type": "svg_circle",
        "ratio": 0.7,
        "style": {
            "background": {
                "fill": "rgba(255,0,0)",
                "fill-opacity": "0.5"
            },
            "svg": {
                "hello": "world"
            }
        }
    }
}
```

!!! note

    - The `ratio` denotes the module size. Defaults to `1`.
    - The `background` arguments will add styling to the `rect` element in the SVG for the background color.
    - The `svg` arguments can be used to add any attribute (XML compatible) and will be added to the top-level `svg` element. This can be usefull to allow for easier targetting through external styles.

!!! warning

    If the `ratio` value approaches `0`, the module size becomes to small for a scanner to read the QR code.

!!! danger

    SVG does not support the following properties in the request body:

      - `logo`
      - `color_mask`
      - `eye_drawer`

### 🟥 Custom Background, SVG Styling, and Smaller Modules

**Request**

```json
{
  "data":"https://example.com",
  "output":{
    "as_json":false,
    "format":"svg"
  },
  "version":5,
  "module_drawer":{
    "ratio":0.7,
    "type":"svg_circle",
    "style":{
      "background":{
        "fill":"rgba(255,0,0)",
        "fill-opacity":"0.5"
      },
      "svg":{
        "hello":"world"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## ℹ️ Additional Notes

* Ensure your `version` and `error_correction` settings are compatible with embedded logos.
* Auto-fit is enabled by default if `version` is not specified.
* Color masks allow gradient and image-based designs for QR codes.
* The API is designed to return either an image or a JSON data URI for integration flexibility.
* A `logo` should be a base64 encoded (PNG/JPEG) image (omit the `data:image/type;...,` prefix).
